name: RFQ clarification list
summary: A buyer sending drawings and specifications out for quotation gets one list of missing details, conflicting revisions and ambiguous tolerances, and a record of each supplier's answers. The buyer approves every message; the engineer settles every technical question.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of the manufacturing purchasing work of clarifying an incomplete request for quotation, with the method written for this template: the checks and their fixed identifiers, the split between details the buyer supplies and questions the engineer settles, and the dated record of supplier answers.
